sys_hub_flow.description:
Given an application scope, this subflow will install the application on the given instance

Inputs:

  • Scope - Scope name of the application you wish to install. To install customization for store application, provide scope name for the store application
  • Instance URL - The URL of the instance where you wish to install the application
  • Credential Alias - The connection and credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role
  • Version - The version of the your company application or customization to store application you wish to install
  • Auto Upgrade Base Application - This field will only be used when customization to store application is installed. Should be set to true if base app should be upgraded along with installation of customization to store app. Else leave it empty as default is false. This field will be ignored if “Base App Version” is provided
  • Base App Version - The version of store application you wish to install
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled"
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Rollback Version - Previous version of the application installed. Can be rolled back too.

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • Missing required parameter scope
  • Application version is currently installed
  • Invalid application downgrade
  • Unable to locate application
  • Latest version is currently installed

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the instance URL used above Learn More

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>true</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes>browserActivatedIn=chrome,integrationActivatedIn=standalone,labelCacheCleanUpExecuted=true,timeFromCreateToActivate=123719101000,viewActivatedIn=naturalLanguage</attributes><authored_on_release_version/><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category display_value="Application Repo">81be942a773f3300d4bdaeca7810619d</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Given an application scope, this subflow will install the application on the given instance</p>
<p><b>Inputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Scope</b> - Scope name of the application you wish to install. To install customization for store application, provide scope name for the store application</li>
   <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the instance where you wish to install the application</li>
   <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The connection and credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role</li>
   <li><b>Version</b> - The version of the your company application or customization to store application you wish to install</li>
   <li><b> Auto Upgrade Base Application</b> - This field will only be used when customization to store application is installed. Should be set to true if base app should be upgraded along with installation of customization to store app. Else leave it empty as default is false. This field will be ignored if “Base App Version” is provided</li>
   <li><b>Base App Version</b> - The version of store application you wish to install</li>
   <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Outputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
  <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs</li>
<li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
   <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
<li><b>Rollback Version</b> - Previous version of the application installed. Can be rolled back too.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Error Messages:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li>User does not have access to CICD role</li>
   <li>Missing required parameter scope</li>
   <li>Application version is currently installed</li>
   <li>Invalid application downgrade</li>
   <li>Unable to locate application</li>
   <li>Latest version is currently installed</li>
</ul>
<p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the instance URL used above <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn More</a></p></description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority/><generation_source/><internal_name>cicd_install_application_with_scope</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.offering","label":"Input➛Offering","type":"string","base_type":"string","attributes":{"sourceUiUniqueId":"","sourceType":"","sourceId":"","uiUniqueId":"c4242107-a07e-4084-8fa4-04ef2913bfc9"}},{"name":"subflow.selected_options","label":"Input➛Selected display_value="Application Repo">81be942a773f3300d4bdaeca7810619d</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Given an application scope, this subflow will install the application on the given instance</p>
<p><b>Inputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Scope</b> - Scope name of the application you wish to install. To install customization for store application, provide scope name for the store application</li>
   <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the instance where you wish to install the application</li>
   <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The connection and credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role</li>
   <li><b>Version</b> - The version of the your company application or customization to store application you wish to install</li>
   <li><b> Auto Upgrade Base Application</b> - This field will only be used when customization to store application is installed. Should be set to true if base app should be upgraded along with installation of customization to store app. Else leave it empty as default is false. This field will be ignored if “Base App Version” is provided</li>
   <li><b>Base App Version</b> - The version of store application you wish to install</li>
   <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Outputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
  <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs</li>
<li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
   <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
<li><b>Rollback Version</b> - Previous version of the application installed. Can be rolled back too.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Error Messages:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li>User does not have access to CICD role</li>
   <li>Missing required parameter scope</li>
   <li>Application version is currently installed</li>
   <li>Invalid application downgrade</li>
   <li>Unable to locate application</li>
   <li>Latest version is currently installed</li>
</ul>
<p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the instance URL used above <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn
